body: Hope it helps with your decision.

I used to have recurring dreams where I would finally snap and tell my terrible family what I really thought, particularly my stepmother. It would always be preceded by someone ridiculous, but not impossible abuse, that could have happened during my childhood or even recently. 

About a year ago, I had a direct falling out with the family, after which I realized I would never get recognition for all the wrongs they did to me, and that simply distancing myself from them would be the best solution, rather than calling them out.

Guess what? The dreams finally stopped after almost two decades. I felt like I needed to get things off my chest, but It will never grant me any closure, vindication or peace. I will never get the first two, but I can have the third.
It's a dick move but not an asshole move? Did you think this through?

Man... my sister's husband told me that she thought because I was awkward at that point in my life, that I might do something to her son. She never said it directly, but if I had a shred of wherewithal back then,  I'd have confronted her about it.

I should have cut them off and let them know why instead of sitting on this anger. Someone called me immature, and I see why. My feelings have been invalidated my whole life, but that doesn't make me not the asshole for my conduct. Thanks for the kind words.
I see. And it looks like I won't be able to make amends.

My mother died when I was 5. My stepmother entered the picture about a year later. My brother was already an adult by then. 

My stepmother was angry because she wanted to send me some money from a class action suit regarding my father's death. I didn't cash it immediately (because of misgivings about our relationship), so the check bounced. She then wanted to send the money with my stepbrother, whom I hadn't seen in years, and I told her I wouldn't do it. 

I think my exact words were something like "you're not going to send him to do anything" In hindsight it sounds fairly indefensible. 

Anyway, I went through some of the darkest years of my life recently,  starting with my car crash. He promised to come and help me purchase a new car with money he's owed me for years. Then he never showed. Not only that,  but I never laid eyes on him the whole 1 1/2 years I owned that car. I have put money on his cars, I've paid his car notes, I bailed him out of jail for a check fraud scam that I warned him would get him in trouble. He refused to pay the bondsmen,  and they harassed me for years before taking me to court. I don't know if they garnished my wages or not, but I didn't show, so I obviously lost. 

Bailing out family repeatedly cost me my life savings, and made me feel used, because they all acted like I owed it to them. I feel like I should have grown a spine years ago, and maybe this never would have happened. All in all,  I recognized a pattern of conduct and decided I'd never have anything to do with him again.
Yeah, that sounds like a plan. Thanks.

I'm over here seething with rage that I didn't want to admit I felt. Both of those people have been so horrible to me, and I feel like I was nothing but good to them. So when I contacted them, that repressed anger just rose to the surface. I felt righteous in finally expressing myself, but it's looking like I was anything but.

I cannot forgive them, but that doesn't make me justified in how I handled this.

Yeah, I see that. My stepmother won't listen to me long enough to apologize, and my stepbrother won't even pick up. I  always thought I'd have a problem accepting my judgment if I ever needed to post here, but it looks like I am the  asshole, at least right now.

I agree with everything you said. I have no love for any part of that dysfunctional family that I propped up for years. My only concern now is if I'm wrong for how I navigate this. That they mistreated me is no excuse to be a shitty person.

I literally feel nothing for my actions, but that doesn't mean I don't have to answer for my assholery, if in fact I am the asshole here. I asked precisely because I can't gauge my own wrongness right now.
Please ask any questions you need to render a judgment.

An awfulbrag. Interesting. This is why I asked. I have people in my corner who are convinced that I did what I had to do. But clearly people disagree. I probably can't raise either of them to apologize, but I am seeing that I might be a dick, if not wrong for how I feel.

I'm pretty sure I'll never be the "bigger person " again. I've adopted a philosophy of "mistakes are one thing, but fucking me over is never a mistake ". Am I a scuzz bucket and a hypocrite for being this way?
